request.name: dane-teen-phone-01
request.prompt: A big strong Great Dane dog running and swinging its owner through the air on a taut red leash: the owner is a lanky teenager in a hoodie, flying horizontally, completely calm, staring at his smartphone and not noticing anything. Red collar, red leash. Stylized simple 3D render, rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte flat-colored surfaces, no textures, no visible polygon facets, slightly oversized heads, small dot eyes, soft daylight, soft short shadow on the ground. Three-quarter view from above, plain light grey background, no environment. No text.
